# ship-workspaces

Your interface to the `workspaces` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`workspaces.active`](references/docs/workspaces.active.mdoc) — Currently-active workspace id (null if none).
- [`workspaces.list`](references/docs/workspaces.list.mdoc) — Known project workspaces with active flag per row.
